queries.name: GetReferenceById
queries.output: current reference projection plus revision/lifecycle; Customer includes current Account Code claim summary/history count; Contact includes current affiliation plus active-channel count/first bounded page; Dispatch includes current_address projection source
rules: historical lookup may return archived records
large collections use dedicated paginated subqueries

queries.name: ListActiveReferences
queries.pagination: deterministic keyset cursor over normalized display sort key then immutable ID; caller limit clamped to bounds.json; no OFFSET scan for ordinary navigation
rules: Dispatch optional Site/customer context is presentation metadata only

queries.name: MatchCustomerOrganization
rules: Account Code is preferred stable external evidence
display name alone never authorizes identity mutation
candidate_count reflects complete union while IDs paginate

queries.name: PreviewCustomerAccountCodeConflict
rules: hash binds complete conflict state through generation/count/target/source state even when display paginates
mutating command recomputes snapshot under UnitOfWork

queries.name: GetCustomerAccountCodeHistory
queries.rule: superseded claims remain historical evidence; opening/superseding command provenance is queryable and never becomes current matching authority

queries.name: GetContactChannels
rules: ordinary recipient selection requests active channels only
historical/admin view may request archived channels

queries.name: ValidateContactChannelForUse
rules: AUTO_SELECT never guesses between multiple usable channels unless consuming workflow has separately accepted deterministic rule

queries.name: MatchContact
rules: email equality outside requested scope is not candidate collision
candidate_count reflects complete union and IDs paginate in stable immutable-ID order
ambiguous remains ambiguous regardless visible page

queries.name: GetContactAffiliationHistory
queries.rule: history reads preserved relationship rows including opening/closing command provenance; current Customer labels do not rewrite historical operational snapshots

queries.name: PreviewReferenceArchive
queries.rule: eligibility derives from complete blocker count; ArchiveReference reruns bounded guards inside authoritative UnitOfWork

queries.name: GetSetting
rules: absent row returns code-defined default without insertion

queries.name: ListSettingsForOwner
queries.output: registered definitions joined to optional persisted values

performance_rules: ordinary collection queries use keyset cursors over supporting indexes
exact COUNT not performed by default except workflows that require it
route-supplied type/sort identifiers resolve through closed enums and never raw SQL fragments
